input.evidence: The ExportButton component sets 'busy' to true on click and resets it to false only on success; if exportReport rejects (i.e., export fails), busy remains true, causing the Export button to stay disabled. The code needs to catch errors and reset 'busy' to false on failure to re-enable the button.
